synthetic_hidden_album.description: SYNTHETIC. Built by hand for PR #1434 because the only real extraction carrying this store is from a case that cannot be shared or sanitized. Nothing here came from a device: secured.db holds a files table created with the column names the module reads (plus _id), so it tests the parser's logic and says nothing about Samsung's real schema, column types or units. The sec_pass images are 16x16 solid-colour placeholders. Four rows: (1) _data resolves to an extracted JPEG, date_added and date_modified in seconds, datetime in milliseconds; (2) _data resolves to an extracted PNG, captured_url set, datetime NULL; (3) _data names sec_pass/gallery/20240401_080000.jpg, which was not extracted, while a same-named file sits in sec_pass/other, so the media column must stay empty; (4) _data, _size and every timestamp NULL or 0, which must not raise. Expected: 4 rows, 2 with media.
